title: Slovakia finds Russian backdoor in traffic speed cameras
summary: Slovakia has discovered a Russian backdoor embedded in their national traffic speed camera infrastructure, raising significant concerns about foreign interference in critical national infrastructure systems.
problem_solved: Reveals a potential state-sponsored espionage and sabotage vector targeting critical transportation infrastructure.
why_valuable: Highlights the growing threat of supply chain attacks and foreign backdoors in essential public infrastructure, emphasizing the need for rigorous security auditing of critical systems.
